notes: WhatNow SF's whole beat is businesses taking spaces, so its stories carry a street number more reliably than any other feed here — but its San Francisco edition also files stories from down the Peninsula under the same tag, and one of the four in this batch is in Mountain View.

coverage.note: Four items queued, all four read. Two named a San Francisco building. The Original Joe's story also names 144 Taylor St and 601 Union St, the chain's 1937 and present locations — history of the business, not of the West Portal building — so neither is a finding here.

findings.description: Original Joe's Cable Car, a restaurant from the family that runs Original Joe's, is slated to take this West Portal storefront, with a debut expected in late 2027.

citation.label: What Now San Francisco, “Original Joe’s Cable Car To Open In West Portal,” 21 August 2026

raw.text: Original Joe's Cable Car is slated to open at 385 West Portal Ave. in San Francisco's West [Portal]… The restaurant is expected to debut in late 2027

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 385 WEST PORTAL AVE → parcel 3012028; sf-parcels has blklot 3012028 active, 381–385 WEST PORTAL; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1992. EAS puts 381, 385 WEST PORTAL AVE on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 381.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.

publish.note: The parcel was seeded earlier in this run from research/manifests/news-2026-08-25.json; there was no page at /san-francisco/west-of-twin-peaks/west-portal-avenue/381/ before it.
